name: Reports switches from Aged Receivables to Loan Tape Report
description:
1. Sign in and open Reports.
2. Open Aged Receivables from the Pre Defined Reports catalog tab.
3. Return to the catalog and choose Loan Tape Report.
4. Verify the selected report and settled result state.
